summary: Tested Keystone lead-capture onboarding end-to-end. Backend: 39/39 tests pass (added /api/leads, /api/admin/leads create/list/delete + subscribers upsert). Frontend: Modal opens on 6 of 7 expected triggers (hero pill, hero CTA, desktop nav, featured primary, featured secondary, footer); auto-opens on /category/smart-investing and /product/keystone-investors-club; does NOT open on other 4 categories. Form submission posts to /api/leads, shows confirm step with 'Welcome to the circle.', calls window.open(externalUrl, '_blank'). ESC, close button, and backdrop all dismiss the modal in form state. BUG FOUND: featured-financial-link-strip is rendered as <a target='_blank' href={external_url}> and bypasses the modal — it should call openOnboarding().

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid='featured-financial-link-strip' is an <a target='_blank' href={SMART_INVESTING_EXTERNAL_URL}> that navigates directly to the external URL, BYPASSING the onboarding modal. Per spec it must call openOnboarding() like the primary/secondary CTAs.

Verify with a quick Playwright re-run on data-testid='featured-financial-link-strip' that the modal opens (instead of opening external in a new tab directly).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Only one functional bug remains: FeaturedFinancialSection.jsx line ~207-223 renders the link strip as a real <a target='_blank' href={SMART_INVESTING_EXTERNAL_URL}>. The file already imports useKeystoneOnboarding so fix is trivial — replace the <a> with a <button type='button'> calling openOnboarding(SMART_INVESTING_EXTERNAL_URL, 'featured-financial-link-strip'). All other CTAs (hero pill, hero CTA, desktop nav, footer, featured primary, featured secondary, mobile nav, category page auto-open, product page auto-open) verified working. Backend test_leads.py covers POST /api/leads (200 + 422), GET /api/admin/leads (auth + content), subscriber upsert idempotency, DELETE /api/admin/leads/{id}. Window.open spy pattern used: page.add_init_script overwrites window.open and stores calls in window.__openCalls — works reliably for verifying external new-tab redirect without actually navigating.
rca of the issue: RCA — FeaturedFinancialSection.jsx link strip: The author wired the two primary/secondary CTAs through openOnboarding() but forgot to migrate the standalone bottom link strip (kept as an <a target=_blank>). Reproduction: load home, scroll to 'Why Smart Investing With Keystone' section, click the rounded 'EXPLORE THE SMART INVESTING DESTINATION' bar at the bottom — it opens https://wealth-unlock-3.emergent.host/ in a new tab without showing the lead-capture modal. Mitigation: convert the <a> to a <button type='button' onClick={() => openOnboarding(SMART_INVESTING_EXTERNAL_URL, 'featured-financial-link-strip')}> so the modal captures the lead first, then the modal itself opens the external URL via window.open after confirm.
